name: Lack of Surplus
summary: Dar needs more sawtooth meat for the eastern beach outpost. Tok'Kar has little time between guard shifts and cooking for the soldiers, so Dar asks you to bring some.

sections.title: Supplies for the Shore
sections.body: Dar is gathering supplies for the outpost on the eastern beach. Tok'Kar guards the post and cooks for its soldiers, leaving little time for other work. The soldiers enjoy sawtooth meat when they can get it. Dar has not had time to send another shipment.

sections.title: Choosing the Meat
sections.body: Older sawtooths taste better, Dar says, so leave the young ones alone. They need a year or two to reach full size. Bring eight unprepared sawtooth flanks to Tok'Kar in the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: Who is requesting the sawtooth meat?
faq.answer: Dar, who is stocking the outpost on the eastern beach with supplies.
Tok'Kar is stationed at the outpost on the eastern beach, in the Swamp of Sorrows. Bring the meat there.

faq.q: Why does Tok'Kar need others to bring meat?
faq.answer: Guard shifts and cooking for the soldiers leave Tok'Kar little time in the day.
Hunt older sawtooths. The young ones are less tasty and need a year or two to reach full size.
Bring Tok'Kar eight unprepared sawtooth flanks.

faq.q: What comes next in the chain?
faq.answer: A second step under the same name follows.
